title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 3
description: Multimodal recordings from 29 participants who watched six educational videos in two conditions: an attentive session followed by factual multiple-choice questions, and a distracted session with a silent backwards-counting task. The videos covered three presentation styles. Recorded signals include EEG, ECG, EOG, gaze, pupil size, blinks, saccades and head position. Questionnaire data, including the ASRS adult ADHD symptom checklist and the stimulus knowledge questions, are provided as phenotype files.
methods_description: Participants watched six informational videos, two from each of three presentation styles (presenter with animation, presenter with glassboard, animation with writing hand). In session 1 (attentive) they answered 11-12 multiple-choice questions after each video. In session 2 (distracted) they watched the same videos in the same order while silently counting backwards from a random prime number in steps of 7, with no test afterward. EEG, ECG, EOG, head motion, gaze coordinates and pupil size were recorded. EEG was converted to BDF, and physiological and eye-tracking data to compressed TSV.
